description: nhflow_3d_si_mb_basin_fine (4 wavy blocks, sloshing from the initial step) stratified: salinity 30 at the bed level 0 to 0 at 5 m (A 611), a temperature front along the blocks (A 603), UNESCO density (A 620 2) with the pressure gradient of Shchepetkin and McWilliams across the curvilinear blocks. Closed basin: the mass of both tracers to round-off. At rest (without F 72 and A 605 0.7 0) the largest velocity stays at 1e-13 m/s over 2 h.
covers: nhflow_amr::si_step with A 620: si_old_closed, si_tracer phase 1, si_density per block
baroclinic_face across block faces (the outer columns from the filled tracer mask), curvilinear cell vector
